messages.subject: Calderwell CV-7 - notification of safety-related defect and proposed voluntary recall
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Whitlow,

On behalf of Calderwell Mobility Limited we attach a notification of a safety-related defect affecting the Calderwell CV-7 (regenerative braking control, firmware 4.2.x), together with the proposed voluntary recall action plan. 2,140 vehicles are affected; a validated corrective firmware build is ready to deploy.

Given the safety dimension the company wishes to launch without delay and would welcome a recall reference and any further information you require.

Yours sincerely,
Tom Gallagher
Whitfield Carter LLP

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
